description: Frozen search configuration for one optimization round (v4.3).

base_params.description: Accepted params for delta mode: {"gain_db": float, "freq_hz": float}.

protected_bands.description: Optional list of [lo_hz, hi_hz, max_log_change_db] guard bands.

intent.description: Short English description of the inferred intent, e.g. 'increase brightness moderately'.

objective_id.description: Unique id for this round, e.g. '20261009-brighter-01'. All scores in this round share it; a re-plan gets a new id and scores are never mixed across ids.

status.description: 'unsupported' means the capability check failed; no search should start.

target_intervals.description: dimension name -> [lo, hi]; must lie inside the dimension's typical range.

clap_prompt.description: English descriptive prompt for the CLAP slow loop, e.g. 'a bright lead synth with airy highs'. No negations, no abstract words. Optional; falls back to the raw instruction.

dsp_scores.description: dimension name -> relevance score 0-10; scores <3 are zeroed, rest L1-normalized.

clap_weight.description: CLAP vs DSP blend ratio; 0.0 = pure DSP.

title: CriticConfig
